Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-chokotto-tenranzan/

Walk with a guide and discover the subtle changes in nature that you might miss on an ordinary walk. This is a short, easy-to-enjoy tour. Please join us!

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person, ¥1,500 for repeat visitors, ¥4,000 per family (includes guide and insurance)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Kojima Tsubasa (Hanno City Ecotourism Citizen Guides Association, Creatures Division)

【What to bring】
Drink, rain gear, backpack or similar (something that leaves both hands free is recommended), towel, insect repellent spray
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
